ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَاخْلَعْ عَلَيْنَا خِلَعَ الرِّضْوَانِ وَالْوِدَادِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa ‘khla` `alaynā khila`a ‘r-Riḍwāni wa ‘l-Widād.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and confer upon us the honorable robe of pleasure and affection!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَتَوِّجْنَا بِتَاجِ الْقَبُوْلِ بَيْنَ الْعِبَادِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa tawwijnā bitāji ‘l-qabūli bayna ‘l-ibād.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and crown us with a crown of acceptance among the servants!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَارْأَفْ بِنَا رَأْفَةَ الْحَبِيْبِ بِحَبِيْبِهِ يَوْمَ التَّنَادِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa ‘r ’af bi nā ra’fata ‘l-Ḥabībi bi Ḥabībihī Yawma ‘t-Tanād.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and be kind to us like lover is to his beloved, on the Day of Calling!
